description: This file defines a mock class 'DataReaderMock' for testing purposes, which inherits from 'IDataReader' and uses Google Mock to mock the 'readData' method. It is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace and is used for unit testing within the Rialto media server component.

classes.name: DataReaderMock
classes.description: A mock class for IDataReader used in testing, providing a mocked implementation of the 'readData' method.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Mocked method that simulates reading media data, returns a vector of media segments.
